test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

In addition with / the existing crisis in economy, / the rise of hunger index / is another cause of worry.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. In addition with .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"In addition with"** is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"In addition to"** to indicate adding information.
 
• The corrected sentence should read: *In addition to the existing crisis in economy, the rise of hunger index is another cause of worry.*

Correct sentence: *In addition to the existing crisis in economy, the rise of hunger index is another cause of worry*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Common phrases with "In addition to":**
 
 
• **Example:** In addition to his job, he volunteers at a local shelter.
 
• **Usage:** Used to add information or items to a list.
